title: Stay Cool by Broadway
description:
Experience late summer and early fall in downtown Nashville from this stylish condo near Broadway. Enjoy contemporary comforts, a heated pool, and convenient access to live music, restaurants, rooftop destinations, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, SoBro, The Gulch, and Germantown. Explore downtown, then return to a comfortable space to relax and recharge.

The space
Step into the energy of Nashville during late summer and early fall from this stylish downtown condo just a short walk from Broadway. With contemporary design, premium touches, and inviting living spaces, the condo offers a comfortable retreat while keeping downtown attractions within easy reach. Spend the day discovering local restaurants, rooftop destinations, live music venues, and entertainment, then return to unwind by the heated pool. The central location provides convenient access to Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, and nearby neighborhoods including The Gulch, SoBro, and Germantown. Whether the day includes a concert, sporting event, dinner downtown, or exploring Music City, this modern condo combines a convenient location with a relaxing space to recharge.
